# WPCarePoint (https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/)

> WPCarePoint is a UK Web Development, eCommerce & AI Solutions Agency. Building, improving and supporting digital businesses.

For complete current service scope, engineering standards, process overview, and frequently asked questions, see: [llms-full.txt](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/llms-full.txt)

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/) — Overview of core web engineering, eCommerce, automation, website care, and search capabilities.
- [Services Hub](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/) — Complete directory of our five core service categories and supporting technical services.
- [About WPCarePoint](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/about/) — Engineering approach, core values, technology stack, and client-ownership commitment.
- [Contact WPCarePoint](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/contact/) — Direct technical scoping by email at contact@wpcarepoint.co.uk.

## Five Core Service Categories
- [Website Design & Development](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/website-development/) — Bespoke WordPress block architecture and React, Next.js, and TypeScript web applications.
- [eCommerce Development](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ecommerce-development/) — WooCommerce (HPOS) and custom online stores configured for GBP (£), UK VAT rules, Stripe SCA, and Royal Mail / DPD shipping.
- [AI & Business Automation](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-business-automation/) — Practical workflow automation, enquiry triage, CRM and API integrations built with UK GDPR boundaries and human approval.
- [Website Care & Technical Support](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/website-care-support/) — Essential, Advanced, and Elite Care Plans (Enquire for Pricing) plus one-off WordPress Quick Fix remediation.
- [SEO & AI Search Optimisation](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-search-optimisation/) — Technical SEO foundations, Schema.org JSON-LD graphs, and consolidated AI Search Optimisation (GEO & AIO) for Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

## Supporting & Specialist Services
- [WordPress Speed Optimisation](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/wordpress-speed-optimisation/) — Diagnostic bottleneck resolution for Core Web Vitals, images, caching, scripts, databases, and UK hosting.
- [Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/search-engine-optimisation/) — Technical crawl audits, semantic site architecture, 301 redirect hygiene, and UK search readiness.
- [Custom Web Solutions & Integrations](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/custom-web-solutions-integrations/) — Tailored web modules, client interfaces, and validated server-side REST and webhook integrations.
- [AI-Powered Website Development](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/ai-powered-website-development/) — Scoped interactive website intelligence, grounded search, and guided qualification helpers with human guardrails.
- [Branding & Brand Identity](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/branding-brand-identity/) — Cohesive visual systems, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast palettes, typography scales, and reusable web design tokens.
- [Digital Marketing & Online Growth](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/services/digital-marketing-online-growth/) — Conversion-focused landing architecture and privacy-respecting growth programmes.

## Care Plans & Commercial Approach
- **Essential Care, Advanced Care & Elite Care**: Scoped transparently to match platform architecture and operational complexity (**Enquire for Pricing**).
- **One-Off WordPress Quick Fix**: Standalone technical repair pathway without mandatory monthly retainer lock-in.
- **Ownership**: Clients retain full ownership of domains, hosting accounts, code repositories, and content.
